name: devant
description: A single-command, intent-aware coding companion. Onboards by scanning the repo with its own built-in graph, captures the project's vision/direction/non-goals/rules as a local intent graph you own, and works like a teammate who knows what to do and what NOT to do. Lean, fast, ceremony scaled to blast radius. Everything it stores stays local and is never committed.

smart_compact.title: Smart compaction
smart_compact.description: Phase-gated smart compaction (dec-018): defer auto-compact mid-phase; land it at phase boundaries.

compact_floor_pct.title: Compact floor (%)
compact_floor_pct.description: Context % where the pending-compact notification arms. To actually compact this early locally, set BOTH CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW and CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE in settings env (the override only applies when the window is set).

context_window_tokens.title: Context window (tokens)
context_window_tokens.description: Auto-compact window used for context-% math. Match CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW if you set it.
